newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries unchanged, claims drop erases gains.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries unchanged, claims drop erases gains.

text.p: *U.S. Treasuries unchanged after huge drop in jobless claims
*Claims fall 42,000 to 299,000 in week ended July 19, lowest
level in a year. Special factors, though, said skewed data
*Labor mkt said very tight. Strong July payrolls report seen
*Mortgage application volume index up 1.1 pct in July 18 week
